limitations: No grand total wall time is reported: phases overlapped on a shared host, and many measured clocks are nested. Per-phase sums are work-duration summaries, not isolated end-to-end latency.
Parent process CPU includes its own threads but excludes native child CPU; CPU time can exceed wall time under numerical-library threading.
Main outer-envelope residual includes data generation, persistence and verified archive processing together; an isolated main archive timer was not recorded.
Main replay native operation counts are source-derived from completed frozen loops. Replay IPC and audit parent CPU were not measured and remain null.

Per-model main mean/p95 latency is pooled complete control-episode elapsed time from final RESULTS, including task file readbacks/deliveries and actions; it is not primitive neuron or native kernel latency.
Transport file-readback counts refer to required application payload reads; hashing, metadata reads, cache effects and operating-system syscall totals are not counted.
Numeric PNG/text transport is a controlled lossless fixture. Logical event counts and file bytes do not establish network, energy or biological spike efficiency.
The reused native binary retains a verified prior exact-source build receipt. This reporting round did not compile Rust; original build timings are excluded.

Pre-freeze development, baseline experiments, proof/engineering fixtures, source restoration, independent review/report writing, final publication compression and upload are outside these registered phase totals.
No measured energy, GPU time, monetary charge, total child CPU or total adapter write amplification is available. Missing values are null, not zero.

main_driver_calendar_interval.scope: Main driver calendar interval only; includes waiting and concurrent-host effects, not sum of every research phase

main_episode_latency_from_final_RESULTS.scope: Pooled full control episode (public acquisitions, policy, actual delivery/readback and scoring); not isolated inference latency

feedback_confirmation.count_status: Recorded full native replay count, independently verified against all saved channel receipts

main_confirmation.count_status: Exactly derived from successfully completed frozen audit loops, not separately instrumented counters
main_confirmation.formula: one sparse model x n trajectories x 4 stages; ticks per trajectory 6+7+7+8=28

feedback_confirmation_evaluation.scope: Five evaluations including actual file transports and archive compression; excludes outer DATA/ROWS/summary serialization and separate replay audits

feedback_confirmation_replay_audit.scope: Separate full artifact and native replay audits; AUDIT recorded_native_roundtrip_ns refers to original evaluation, not replay latency

feedback_training.scope: Train/development acquisition, native features, supervised deliveries, archive and head fitting; excludes outer dataset/summary serialization

main_confirmation_scope_envelopes.scope: Sum of 15 sequential scope envelopes: data generation, evaluation, independent replay, persistence and verified archives; nested components must not be added again

main_training.scope: Five fits and development selection after dataset generation/NPZ writes; final model/receipt file writes are outside timer

retention_confirmation.scope: Full scoring, checkpoint readback and raw array persistence; final publication tar compression excluded

retention_preparation.scope: 120 registered online/replay optimizations, 60 checkpoint persistence/reload continuations and preparation receipts; guard heads reuse online fits

runtime_qualification.scope: Fifteen qualification profiles including fresh processes, negative interventions and deterministic tail fixtures; timings and operations are nested

sampling_counts.independence_note: Model comparisons, repeated windows, horizons, recovery checks and assertion counts are not additional independent trajectories; training-seed replication remains five.
